svg.aria-label: How Smart Mobility Platform works: DATA SOURCES: GPS, AIS, sensors, ticketing and weather. → INGESTION: Kafka and MQTT streams, plus batch ETL. → PROCESSING: Apache Spark, feature engineering, data quality. → MODELS: LSTM and GNN forecasting, anomaly detection, RL optimiser. → API: FastAPI endpoints with WebSocket updates. → DASHBOARD: Streamlit views for live monitoring and forecasts.
